name: Meta Ads playbook
shortDescription: How Bots run Meta ads safely: budgets in the right units, paused-first campaigns, approval before going live, and Meta's own rules for each tool.
longDescription: Comes with the Meta Ads app: every Bot with access to Meta Ads gets this Skill automatically. It covers reporting, the campaign → ad set → creative → ad workflow, draft mode, and the money rules that keep a Bot from spending what the Owner did not approve.
attribution: Written by Supernala from Meta's Ads MCP server tool guidance and documentation.
